description: Nullability and parameter typing against MariaDB: comparisons, BETWEEN, IN, NOT and OR over a NULL price read as NULL booleans while IS NULL and <=> do not; a CTE and a derived table before a RIGHT join read NULL ids where they have no row; a count subquery without GROUP BY reads 0; a parameter inside DATE_ADD(..., INTERVAL ? DAY) takes a number and one in a VALUES subquery takes the author's name; row comparisons and row IN lists type their parameters. A column beside an aggregate without GROUP BY reads NULL in the one row MariaDB returns when nothing matches.
